title: Iris-Z: Scaling One Generative Model Past Specialist Geometry Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16010v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language moved from many task-specific models to one unified model: a single generative model with a single generative training task that handles all of them within the same backbone, and keeps improving with data, parameters and compute. We believe the bitter lesson applies just as much to computer vision, 3D and spatial understanding, in the end to visual intelligence: the effort should go into general architectures that solve all these tasks in a unified way, and into scaling them, rather than into task-specific designs. We test this on monocular geometry, a task that has belonged to specialised architectures for years. Iris-Z is a general image generator that produces appearance and geometry together. A single backbone denoises, reasons about and understands the image and its depth at the same time, and one set of weights generates images with their depth, estimates depth from photographs and paints images onto a given depth. translated_title: Iris-Z：让单一生成模型超越专用几何模型
translated_abstract: 语言领域已经从众多任务专用模型走向了统一模型：即一个采用单一生成式训练任务的生成模型，它在同一骨干网络内处理所有任务，并随着数据、参数和算力的增长持续提升。我们认为“苦涩的教训”同样适用于计算机视觉、3D 与空间理解，乃至最终的视觉智能：研究精力应当投入到能以统一方式解决所有这些任务的通用架构及其规模化扩展上，而不是任务专用设计。我们在单目几何这一长期属于专用架构的任务上验证了这一理念。Iris-Z 是一个通用图像生成器，能够同时生成外观与几何。单一骨干网络同时对图像及其深度进行去噪、推理与理解，仅需一组权重即可完成：生成带深度的图像、从照片估计深度，以及将图像绘制到给定深度上。
tldr: Iris-Z 用单一生成模型骨干同时完成图像生成、深度估计和深度条件绘制等单目几何任务，证明通用生成架构经过规模化可以超越专用几何模型。
